metric: granularity diagnostic + compliant ARI upper bound (oracle piecewise chunking per gold segment), per document per N in the frozen grid
authority: external review R-B (ADOPTION.md §132); revisions require a new ledger ruling before any real-corpus run
oracle_rule: each gold segment split into ceil(seg_chars/N) even pieces, pieces never cross segment boundaries, unit assigned to the piece containing its char_span start; this is the upper bound for any real chunker with max_chars<=N because crossing segment boundaries can only lower ARI further
ari_bound_semantics: ARI of oracle labels via the same frozen ari_units_vs_chunks (denominator unchanged); ari_bound is a structural ceiling of the gold-vs-chunk agreement at that N, not a system score
distribution_disclosure: per-doc segment count and segment_chars {median, mean, max, over_grid_max per N}; corpus-level macro via non-None average, same as baseline/system macro rules
discipline: real run only after G6 freeze and only on the 14 dev docs; ARI denominator is never modified; if ARI<0.75 the gap and its granularity attribution are disclosed openly rather than adjusting the metric; module stays pure functions, no CLI (G7 report wiring gated on gold revision)
